cause: Approved hologram IOR 1.0 does not equal Chunky Air.INSTANCE.ior 1.000293016. PathTracer chooses doRefraction on any unequal IOR. The refractive=false flag disables ray bending, not its independent Schlick-Fresnel reflection branch. specular=0 does not disable this branch. At the approved isometric surface angle the measured Fresnel probability is 0.013486637; multiplied by the 1-alpha transmission branch it is 0.005553321 per front surface. Fancier translucency was already false. The residual glass-like appearance also contains layered RGB-filtered transmission and diffusely lit cubic faces, not exclusively reflection.
plannedFix: Match the actual air IOR, plus use a hologram-only flat alpha/emissive shading branch with straight untinted transmission and no reflected/scattered paths; preserve solid materials and original scene.
